## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build TwitchDock.slnx -c Release` and the unit tests pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated (group reference, README or tutorial) where behavior changed
- [ ] For API work: fixture, tests and `docs/api/coverage.json` evidence ([definition of done](https://github.com/dermixer1305/TwitchDock.NET/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#definition-of-done-for-an-api))
- [ ] Public API snapshot regenerated and reviewed if the public surface changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry for user-visible changes
- [ ] No tokens, secrets or private data in code, fixtures, logs or screenshots
